subprocess_commands: markery matchmaker seed-pairs [<year>|--years Y ...] [--window N] [--min-score S] [--json]
markery historian relevance <project> --title TEXT [--text TEXT] [--json] [--model MODEL]
markery librarian leads-add --source S --id ID [--title ...] [--project ...] [--relevance N] [--status S] [--note ...]

json_contracts.historian card --json: single JSON object {recommendation: confirm|reject|defer, score: 1-5, reasoning: str, card_text: str}
json_contracts.historian digest --json: single JSON object {ranking: str, digest: str}
json_contracts.historian discovery status --json: single JSON object {enabled: bool, projects: [str], sources: [str], relevance_floor: int, last_tick: str|null}
json_contracts.librarian books --json: JSON array of {title, author, year, isbn, action: acquire|ill, ia_id: str|null, worldcat_url: str, ill_request: str}
json_contracts.librarian media-search --json: JSON array of {source: str, id: str}
json_contracts.librarian media-acquire --json: single JSON object {acquired: bool, slug?: str, license?: str, source?: str, title?: str}
json_contracts.matchmaker seed-pairs --json: JSON array of {year, serial, mark, applicant, is_tech, match, owner_conf, assignee, patent_no, app_dt, grant_dt, cpc: [str], delta_years, score}
json_contracts.matchmaker seed-project --json: single JSON object {project, entity_id, canonical, variants: int}

description: Markery CLI subprocess interface contract. Companion repos must call check_contract() against MARKERY_ROOT before invoking these commands. Bump contract_version when any command signature or output format changes. v1.1: --json on historian card/digest. v1.2: discovery-loop surface — historian relevance/discovery, librarian books/media-acquire/use/leads-add (Phase 30). v1.3: media branch — librarian media-search --json and media-acquire --json/--fair-use (non-commercial fair-use tier). v1.4: spawn pipeline (Phase 32 P4) — project init --type, matchmaker seed-pairs/seed-project/build, match, site build.
